Fixes for the large Computer view.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.1.3.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.1.x and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Fixed

- **Mouse and keyboard work in the bot's computer again.** Opening the large view while the screen was already live never actually asked Hermes for control, so the view stayed watch-only (and Hermes dropped the input). Opening now takes control every time; the status dot turns red when you have it, and if control can't be taken the view says so instead of silently ignoring your mouse.
- **No more clash with the window buttons.** The large view now starts below the title bar, so Windows' own minimize / maximize / close stay visible and clickable, and the view's minimize button sits just left of them.
- The title bar strip above the large view still drags the window, and nothing else in the view does, so clicks near the top of the remote screen aren't swallowed.
